title: WashU Racing drives to best finish in club history
summary_en: Members of WashU Racing commit more than 20 hours a week to building and testing a formula-style race car from scratch — six-hour building days, 12-hour testing days and dozens and dozens of meetings designing systems, planning logistics and finding sponsors. That work paid off this spring, when WashU Racing achieved its highest showing in club history at the annual Formula SAE competition.
title_cn: WashU Racing drives to best finish in club history

title: Early-pregnancy air pollution exposure linked to persistent depressive symptoms
summary_en: WashU Bursky Public Health researchers found the first six weeks of pregnancy may be a particularly sensitive period.
title_cn: Early-pregnancy air pollution exposure linked to persistent depressive symptoms

title: Groves named inaugural Stuart A. Kornfeld Distinguished Professor
summary_en: Andrew K. Groves, a renowned developmental biologist known for his research into inner ear development and hearing loss with a focus on the potential for hearing restoration, has been named the inaugural Stuart A. Kornfeld Distinguished Professor of Medical Sciences at WashU Medicine.
title_cn: Groves named inaugural Stuart A. Kornfeld Distinguished Professor

title: Quick optical biopsy could be early detection method for endometrial cancer
summary_en: Biomedical engineer Quing Zhu and WashU Medicine collaborators combined optical coherence tomography and machine learning for a rapid, accurate test for endometrial cancer.
title_cn: Quick optical biopsy could be early detection method for endometrial cancer
